annotation.title_clean: Informe de Ponencia Positiva para primer debate al Proyecto de Ley 043 de 2025 Senado - 324 de 2025 Cámara: Por medio del cual se regula la inteligencia artificial en Colombia
annotation.title_en: Positive Report for First Debate on Bill 043 of 2025 Senate - 324 of 2025 House: Regulating Artificial Intelligence in Colombia
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Congreso de la República de Colombia (Sen. Pedro Hernando Flórez Porras; Rep. Gerson Montaño Arizala), Comisiones Sextas Constitucionales
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Committee report recommending favourable first debate of Colombia's AI bill (043/2025 Senate – 324/2025 House). The bill sets an EU-style four-tier risk framework, designates MinCiencias as national AI authority, creates regulatory sandboxes, mandates impact assessments for high-risk systems, promotes education and just labour transition, and sets graduated liability.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four risk tiers: critical (generally not permitted), high, specific transparency obligations, minimal risk
High-risk list includes AI as safety components of machinery, vehicles and medical devices
MinCiencias designated National AI Authority, with intersectoral committee and expert advisory council
Mandatory impact assessments for high-risk system implementers; regulatory sandboxes
Employers must adopt retraining plans for AI-driven job displacement; existing systems must comply
